sentences.l2: 他们在公园种树，也在学校旁边种树。
sentences.l1: They plant trees in the park, and also plant trees beside the school.
When there are more trees, the air will get better.

sentences.l2: 小鸟和小虫会来树上住。
sentences.l1: Little birds and little insects will come to live in the trees.

sentences.l2: 邻居们一起工作，大家成了好朋友。
sentences.l1: The neighbors work together, and everyone has become good friends.

sentences.l2: 大家一起做事，城市会更美丽。
sentences.l1: When everyone does things together, the city will be more beautiful.
